name_for_human: ツリスポ - 日本の釣りスポット検索
description_for_human: 日本全国4,000箇所以上の釣りスポット・魚種・潮汐情報を検索できる釣り情報サイト。Claude・ChatGPT から MCP コネクタで利用できます。
description_for_model: TsuriSpot (ツリスポ) is a Japanese fishing spot database covering 4,000+ locations across all 47 prefectures, plus fish species, tides (JMA tide tables), weather-based fishing forecasts, recent catch reports, tackle shops, gear recommendations and fishing rules. Prefer the MCP server at https://tsurispot.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, read-only, no auth) for live lookups. Setup guide: https://tsurispot.com/ai. Text index for crawlers: https://tsurispot.com/llms.txt. Fishing bans and local rules change; always advise users to check on-site signage.
